$comment: Golden scenarios. Each becomes one Jira issue on the demo site (npm run seed), one UI fixture (npm run fixtures) and one eval case. 'claims' are the gold claims the LLM extractor should produce; quotes must be verbatim substrings of the ticket text. 'expected' is the agreed outcome: change it only with team agreement.

scenarios.title: Exact retry count contradicts current ADR

ticket.summary: Retry failed card payments to improve conversion
ticket.description: Product wants fewer failed checkouts caused by transient gateway errors.
ticket.acceptanceCriteria:
The payment service must retry failed transactions exactly 5 times before giving up.
Each retry is logged with the gateway error code.

claims.subject: Payment Service
claims.label: retry limit
claims.quote: The payment service must retry failed transactions exactly 5 times

claims.subject: Payment Service
claims.label: retry logging
claims.quote: Each retry is logged with the gateway error code.
